images.caption: The Fairmont Le Château Frontenac, formerly and commonly referred to as the Château Frontenac, is a historic hotel located in Quebec City, Quebec, Canada. The Château Frontenac was completed in 1893, and was designed by American architect Bruce Price. The hotel was a part of a series of Chateauesque-style hotels built for the Canadian Pacific Railway company during the late 19th and early 20th centuries.
